_README: Fixed-wing camera calibration supplied for the 1920x1080 training images.
The 3x3 matrix supplied by the user is stored as fx/fy/cx/cy below.
The distortion vector uses the OpenCV radtan order [k1, k2, p1, p2, k3].
The joint image loader applies distortion correction and resize together.
Replace the IMU bias vectors with signed per-axis stationary-calibration
warning: Camera K and distortion are supplied. images_rectified=false makes the joint loader rectify and resize in one calibrated remap. Set it true only if the stored images have already been rectified. Equal signed per-axis IMU biases were provided by the user: 6 degrees/hour and 30 micro-g.

_README: gps_to_camera_m is the offset from the GPS antenna to the camera,
in BODY axes (x forward, y right, z down), in metres.
GPS measures velocity at the antenna; the camera is what sees the
motion the network must explain. A rigid body in a turn moves its
points at different velocities: v_camera = v_gps + omega x r.
Leave it all zero, or delete this block, for no correction.
Measure it on the airframe; do not guess a wing mount as zero.
